# Foodberg

> Foodberg (foodberg.org) is a global food & agriculture data explorer: historical
> food-commodity prices, USDA WASDE supply & demand, USDA FAS PS&D balance sheets,
> and FAO/FRED/World Bank indicators — with the underlying data and code openly
> available. Part of the Heterodata ecosystem (an Arcanum Research project).

## What this site is

- An interactive explorer over real, cited public data. Foodberg is an educational
  research tool, not an official statistical agency — defer to each named upstream
  source (USDA, FAO, FRED/BLS, World Bank) as authoritative.
- Data is downloadable (CSV + Parquet, never JSON). Code is open source.

## Get the data and the code

- Data bundle (curated, CSV + Parquet, ~12 MB): https://foodberg.org/downloads/foodberg-data.zip
  - Contents: global spot prices, composite food-price indices, economic indicators,
    retail prices, USDA WASDE, and a US+World USDA FAS PS&D extract, plus a data
    dictionary, PROVENANCE.csv and a CC BY 4.0 LICENSE.
- Per-dataset downloads: https://foodberg.org/api/download/{dataset}.csv and .parquet
- Source code (pipeline + SPA, Python + TypeScript, MIT): https://github.com/andenick/Foodberg

## Explore (outputs)

- Price Explorer: https://foodberg.org/explore
- Supply & Demand (USDA PS&D, 1960→present): https://foodberg.org/supply-demand
- Food Price Index: https://foodberg.org/index
- Geographic comparison: https://foodberg.org/geographic
- Historical trends: https://foodberg.org/trends
- Data Sources / methodology: https://foodberg.org/sources

## Data sources

- USDA WASDE / NASS — supply & demand estimates
- USDA FAS PS&D — production, supply & distribution balance sheets
- FAO — food price index and per-country food CPI
- FRED / BLS — macro and food-economic indicators
- World Bank Pink Sheet — global commodity prices

## Ecosystem

- Hub: https://heterodata.org
